description: Decompiled section styles for template "32 sections" (auto-generated).

masthead_ad_bar.name: Masthead Ad Bar
masthead_ad_bar.description: Top-of-email bar with a 'View in browser' link and an inline ad image (desktop + mobile variants).

newsletter_masthead.name: Newsletter Masthead
newsletter_masthead.description: Publication logo, newsletter title image, and dateline. Top identity block for the email.

intro_statement.name: Intro Statement
intro_statement.description: A short introductory editor's note or framing statement rendered below the masthead and before article groups.

ad-block.name: Ad Block
ad-block.description: Inventory-backed ad card hydrated from nfl-editorial/src/content/ads.json.

mobileDescriptionStyles.fontFamily: Share Tech Mono, Courier New, Courier, monospace

calendar_event.name: Calendar Event
calendar_event.description: Generated add-to-calendar card. The build writes an .ics file and injects calendarLink.

section_article_group.name: Section Article Group
section_article_group.description: A named news section (e.g. Top News, World, U.S., Politics) with a bold section heading and 1–5 article cards, each with a thumbnail image, headline, and summary, all linked.

section_more_link.name: Section 'See More' Link
section_more_link.description: A standalone paragraph with a single 'See more [section] news' link appearing below each section article group.

inline_ad_block.name: Inline Ad Block
inline_ad_block.description: Mid- or end-of-email inline advertisement with a small label image, a desktop ad image and a hidden mobile ad image.

tracking_pixel_row.name: Tracking Pixel Row
tracking_pixel_row.description: Hidden div containing a row of tiny 2×6 tracking/preheader pixel images, aria-hidden.

email_footer.name: Email Footer
email_footer.description: Full footer with subscription management text, links, social icons, legal logos, and mailing address. Authored via structured slots (paragraphs / address / unsubscribe_label / social_links) with a legacy footer_html fallback; see components/FooterBody.html.

share_this.name: Share This
share_this.description: Slim, tinted 'share this issue' CTA bar with a statement and Forward-by-email / Open-online buttons. All copy is configurable with sensible defaults.

globalOverrides.description: Mobile font-size lock — sets body copy explicitly on small screens. Same pattern as dense-discovery.

darkModeFlatten.description: Defensive dark-mode fallback. Build-time policy flattens colored sections to dark gray surfaces with off-white text when the recipient client honors prefers-color-scheme: dark.
